pairs.target: dìèrtiān zhàochángshàngkè , tǎ wéi méiyǒu qù ménfáng děng nài lěi .
pairs.english: The next day classes continued as usual; Tavi did not go to the gatehouse to wait for Nerai.
pairs.hanzi: 第二天照常上课，塔维没有去门房等奈蕾。

pairs.target: yìzhí dào dìsāntiān xiàwǔ , tā cái dài zhe yígè ǎigè nǚrén láidào xuégōng .
pairs.english: Not until the third afternoon did she bring a short woman to the academy.
pairs.hanzi: 一直到第三天下午，她才带着一个矮个女人来到学宫。

pairs.target: nǚrén jiānshàng bèizhe mùxiá , jìnwū xiān zhǎo dìfāng xiè bāo , jiàn tǎ wéi qǐshēn ràngzuò , biàn bǎ mùxiá fàngdào tā téngchū de yǐzi shàng .
pairs.english: The woman carried a wooden case on her shoulder; entering, she first sought somewhere to set it down, and seeing Tavi rise to offer his seat, put the case on the chair he had freed.
pairs.hanzi: 女人肩上背着木匣，进屋先找地方卸包，见塔维起身让座，便把木匣放到他腾出的椅子上。

pairs.target: " duōxiè , yāo kuài duàn le . "
pairs.english: “Thank you, my back is nearly broken.”
pairs.hanzi: “多谢，腰快断了。”

pairs.target: tā zìjǐ réngjiù zhàn zhe , róu le róu hòubèi .
pairs.english: She herself stayed standing, rubbing her back.
pairs.hanzi: 她自己仍旧站着，揉了揉后背。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī jiào tā yú shīfu , jiǎn lǎoshī què jiào le tā de míngzì , wèn tā shàng huí jiè zǒu de shū héshí sònghuán .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey called her Master Yu, but Instructor Jian used her name, asking when she would return the book borrowed last time.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师叫她虞师傅，简老师却叫了她的名字，问她上回借走的书何时送还。

pairs.target: yú shīfu shuō zài xiázǐ lǐ , wānyāo zhǎo le bàntiān , zhī náchū yìzhī yóu zhǐbāo .
pairs.english: Master Yu said it was in the case, bent to search for ages, and only produced an oilpaper parcel.
pairs.hanzi: 虞师傅说在匣子里，弯腰找了半天，只拿出一只油纸包。

pairs.target: wūlǐ jìng le yíshùn .
pairs.english: The room went quiet for an instant.
pairs.hanzi: 屋里静了一瞬。

pairs.target: " shū zài lìng yígè xiázǐ lǐ . "
pairs.english: “The book is in the other case.”
pairs.hanzi: “书在另一个匣子里。”

pairs.target: jiǎn lǎoshī méiyǒu shēnshǒu jiē tā fēn lái de táng .
pairs.english: Instructor Jian did not reach for the sweet she offered.
pairs.hanzi: 简老师没有伸手接她分来的糖。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi rěn zhe xiào , tīng nài lěi jièshào láiyì .
pairs.english: Holding back laughter, Tavi listened to Nerai explain their reason for coming.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维忍着笑，听奈蕾介绍来意。

pairs.target: yú shīfu guǎn zhe chéngběi shàng qúkǒu de shuǐchǐ , hòutiān yào qù huàndiào yíkuài lièkāi de biāo bǎn .
pairs.english: Master Yu maintained the water gauge at the upper canal inlet north of town; the day after tomorrow she was going to replace a cracked scale board.
pairs.hanzi: 虞师傅管着城北上渠口的水尺，后天要去换掉一块裂开的标板。

pairs.target: nài lěi lìng yǒu yíduàn àn lù yào héduì , zhènghǎo tóngháng .
pairs.english: Nerai had a separate stretch of bank path to check and could conveniently go along.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾另有一段岸路要核对，正好同行。

pairs.target: biāo bǎn shàng de zì yào zhàojiù chāo , shuǐchǐ de wèizhì yě bùnéng suíbiàn yí , yú shīfu quē gèrén zài chāi bǎn zhīqián jìxià yuányàng .
pairs.english: The writing on the board had to be copied as before, and the gauge's position could not be shifted casually either; Master Yu needed someone to record its original state before removing the board.
pairs.hanzi: 标板上的字要照旧抄，水尺的位置也不能随便移，虞师傅缺个人在拆板之前记下原样。

pairs.target: " nǐ shízì , shǒu yě wěn ba ? "
pairs.english: “You can read, and your hands are steady too, right?”
pairs.hanzi: “你识字，手也稳吧？”

pairs.target: tā wèn de zhíjiē , tǎ wéi què bùgǎn lìkè bǎ liǎngyàng dōu yìng xià .
pairs.english: She asked directly, but Tavi dared not immediately agree to both.
pairs.hanzi: 她问得直接，塔维却不敢立刻把两样都应下。

pairs.target: tā shuō néng chāo , yùjiàn bú rènde de zì huì wèn , huàtú méi nài lěi nàme hǎo .
pairs.english: He said he could copy, would ask about unfamiliar characters, and did not draw maps as well as Nerai.
pairs.hanzi: 他说能抄，遇见不认得的字会问，画图没奈蕾那么好。

pairs.target: yú shīfu bǎ tángbāo shōuhuí xiázǐ , shuō tā yě huà bùhǎo rén , huà shuǐchǐ búbì gěi tā tiān yǎnjīng .
pairs.english: Master Yu put the sweets back in the case, saying she could not draw people well either, and drawing a water gauge did not require adding eyes to it.
pairs.hanzi: 虞师傅把糖包收回匣子，说她也画不好人，画水尺不必给它添眼睛。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī wèn nàtiān tíng butíng shuǐ .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey asked whether the water would be stopped that day.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师问那天停不停水。

pairs.target: " bùtíng , huànbǎn , bú pèng zhá . "
pairs.english: “No shutdown, just replacing the board, not touching the sluice.”
pairs.hanzi: “不停，换板，不碰闸。”

pairs.target: yú shīfu zhǐzhe zìjǐ dàilái de xiǎo tú , yánàn huà chū yíduàn néng zhàn rén de píngtái .
pairs.english: Pointing to the little sketch she had brought, Master Yu marked out a platform along the bank where someone could stand.
pairs.hanzi: 虞师傅指着自己带来的小图，沿岸画出一段能站人的平台。

pairs.target: tā yào tǎ wéi liúzài kàoqiáng de yícè , gōngjù hé chāixiàlái de jiù bǎn dōu yóu tā de rén bān .
pairs.english: She wanted Tavi to stay on the side by the wall; the tools and removed old board would all be carried by her people.
pairs.hanzi: 她要塔维留在靠墙的一侧，工具和拆下来的旧板都由她的人搬。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànjiàn tú shàng tōngxiàng zhámén de zhǎi tī , xiān wèn shìbushì yě yào guòqù jì .
pairs.english: Seeing the narrow stair leading to the sluice on the drawing, Tavi first asked whether he was also to go over there and record it.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看见图上通向闸门的窄梯，先问是不是也要过去记。

pairs.target: " bú qù . "
pairs.english: “No.”
pairs.hanzi: “不去。”

pairs.target: tā yòng zhǐjiǎ diǎn zhù píngtái jìntóu .
pairs.english: She placed her nail on the end of the platform.
pairs.hanzi: 她用指甲点住平台尽头。

pairs.target: " wǒ jiào nǐ tuì , nǐ jiù tuì , bié máng zhe bǎ zuìhòu yìbǐ bǔ shàng . "
pairs.english: “When I tell you to step back, you step back; don't rush to fill in the final stroke.”
pairs.hanzi: “我叫你退，你就退，别忙着把最后一笔补上。”

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī jiēguò tú , wèn le huíchéng hé jiēyìng de rén .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey took the drawing and asked about the return journey and the person responsible for meeting him.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师接过图，问了回程和接应的人。

pairs.target: yú shīfu shuō zìjǐ huì cóngtóu dàidào wěi , wǔhòu huíchéng ; xiàyǔ biàn bú huànbǎn , zhíjiē sòng rén huílái .
pairs.english: Master Yu said she would escort him throughout and return to town after noon; if it rained, they would skip replacing the board and bring him straight back.
pairs.hanzi: 虞师傅说自己会从头带到尾，午后回城；下雨便不换板，直接送人回来。

pairs.target: jiǎn lǎoshī héduì nàtiān de kè , jiào tǎ wéi bǎ quē de bànrì liànxí nuó dào qiányìtiān xiàwǔ .
pairs.english: Instructor Jian checked that day's classes and told Tavi to move the missed half-day practice to the previous afternoon.
pairs.hanzi: 简老师核对那天的课，叫塔维把缺的半日练习挪到前一天下午。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhè cái míngbái , lǎoshī yǐjīng zài tán zěnme ràng tā qù le .
pairs.english: Only then Tavi understood: the instructors were already discussing how to let him go.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维这才明白，老师已经在谈怎么让他去了。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī què méiyǒu bǎ tú huángěi tā .
pairs.english: But Instructor Vey did not give the drawing back to him.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师却没有把图还给他。

pairs.target: tā kànzhe tā shuō , zhè yítàng yòng yǎnjīng hé bǐ , bú jiè rènhé dōngxī de xìng .
pairs.english: Looking at him, she said this trip would use eyes and a pen, without borrowing any properties from anything.
pairs.hanzi: 她看着他说，这一趟用眼睛和笔，不借任何东西的性。

pairs.target: tā diǎntóu , yòu wèn ruò shì yú shīfu yào jiè , zìjǐ néng bunéng kàn .
pairs.english: He nodded, then asked whether, if Master Yu borrowed properties, he himself could watch.
pairs.hanzi: 他点头，又问若是虞师傅要借，自己能不能看。

pairs.target: " tā yuànyì jiěshì , nǐ biàn tīng . "
pairs.english: “If she wants to explain, you listen.”
pairs.hanzi: “她愿意解释，你便听。”

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī shuōwán , yú shīfu xiào le yìshēng .
pairs.english: When Instructor Vey finished, Master Yu laughed once.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师说完，虞师傅笑了一声。

pairs.target: " xiū gè biāo bǎn , bù yídìng yǒu hǎoxì . "
pairs.english: “Fixing a scale board doesn't necessarily make a show.”
pairs.hanzi: “修个标板，不一定有好戏。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō zìjǐ búshì qù kàn hǎoxì , huà chūkǒu yòu juéde tài zhèngzhòng .
pairs.english: Tavi said he wasn't going to watch a show, then felt the words sounded too solemn once spoken.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说自己不是去看好戏，话出口又觉得太郑重。

pairs.target: nài lěi zài pángbiān mànmàn bāo tángzhǐ , xiàng méi kànjiàn tā liǎnhóng .
pairs.english: Beside him Nerai slowly peeled a sweet wrapper, as though she hadn't noticed him blush.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾在旁边慢慢剥糖纸，像没看见他脸红。

pairs.target: zuìhòu wéi lǎoshī bǎ rìqī xiě zài tú bèi , qiān le zì , gěi tā de zhǐshì yítàng wǎngfǎn de xǔkě .
pairs.english: Finally Instructor Vey wrote the date on the back of the drawing, signed, and gave him permission for just one return trip.
pairs.hanzi: 最后维老师把日期写在图背，签了字，给他的只是一趟往返的许可。

alignment.english: on the back of the drawing

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiēguò lái , zhǐ fù pèngdào hái méi gāntòu de mò , máng bǎshǒu nuókāi .
pairs.english: Tavi took it; the pad of his finger touched the ink before it had dried, and he hurriedly moved his hand away.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维接过来，指腹碰到还没干透的墨，忙把手挪开。

pairs.target: yú shīfu kànzhe nà dào xiǎoxiǎode zhǐyìn , wèn tā shìbushì yǐjīng bǎ zìjǐ yě jì dào tú shàng le .
pairs.english: Master Yu looked at that tiny fingerprint and asked whether he had already recorded himself on the drawing too.
pairs.hanzi: 虞师傅看着那道小小的指印，问他是不是已经把自己也记到图上了。

pairs.target: zhèhuí tǎ wéi xiào chū le shēng .
pairs.english: This time Tavi laughed aloud.
pairs.hanzi: 这回塔维笑出了声。
